GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 560 (26 Nov 45) AG-E
(SCAPIN-353)
APO 500
26 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Japanese Vessels Sunk While Carrying Allied Prisoners of War or Internees.
1. A report will be submitted to this headquarters indicating the Japanese vessels which were sunk while carrying Allied prisoners of war or internees, and will includes the following information:
a. Name of ship, port of embarkation, date, place and circumstances of sinking, and a nominal roll of prisoners of war or internees who died or were lost due to the sinking.
b. A list of all prisoners of war or internees who died of illness or from other causes while aboard Japanese vessels.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
